player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Mwalandile ukuti icifulo nelyo icikuulwa ico mulefwaya ukubomfya tacili ica cine.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Mwalefwaya ukufumya disk mu cikuulwa umushali ifintu.
invalid_move.same_tower: Mwalefwaya ukufumya disk mu lupungu lumo lwine.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Mwalefwaya ukubika disk iikulu pa disc iinono.

outcome.win: Ndemutasha, mwalicimfya icishingacitika ica mu Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: The turn limit has been reached. You correctly placed {pct}% of the disks on Tower C.
